tonight.headline: Zvada's 2 is the hole — the Gordon swap is made
body: Bad news first: Dominic Zvada, the kicker added Thursday morning for Matt Gay, scored 2.0 against Washington (archive); Gay plays Sunday at Las Vegas against Seattle, and anything above 2.0 makes that swap a loss. Good news: Ollie Gordon is in the FLEX now — you made the swap Friday at 16:56 CDMX (activity log), so the lineup as set is the projection lineup.
Daniels 20.3, Likely 27.7 and Zvada 2.0 are banked: 49.96 to 0 against the 9-0 Maye-day. ESPN: 139.7 to 127.2, 57%. No Sunday checks — no projected starter is in doubt. Nothing to do before kickoff.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Maye-day start Alvin Kamara (8.6) — Estime out-touched him 16 to 9 in Week 9 (Yahoo 11 Nov) and Travis Etienne may be activated Saturday (questionable, NFL.com report). Jaxon Smith-Njigba (22.4) and Brock Bowers (15.5) carry their projection; Bowers gets Fernando Mendoza's first NFL start.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A surprise inactive among Taylor, Tuten, Gordon, Golden or Rice — none has a designation on the final reports (NFL.com Week 10). Then Pickens (12.3) or Wilson (12.8, questionable) fills in.

whatWentWrong.title: The kicker stream cost points before Sunday began
whatWentWrong.lead: Zvada for Gay on a 10.7-to-8.3 projection; the projection then fell to 8.1, and Zvada kicked 2.0.

case.label: What happened
case.body: The brief recommended Zvada as a free agent Wednesday; the add was made Thursday 13:16Z. By 22:05Z ESPN had cut him to 8.1 against Gay's 8.3 with no reporting found to explain it. Thursday: 2.0 (archive).

case.label: The rule it bent
case.body: STRATEGY §5: a stream needs a real gap, not a marginal one. 2.4 projected points on a kicker was marginal, and the slot changed for it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Gay scores 2.0 or less Sunday — then the swap ties or wins and closes RIGHT. Anything more closes it WRONG on the outcome. Either way: no kicker stream under a 3-point gap for the rest of the season.
